method: Source inspection of the app diff, then a replay of the round 1 independent walkthrough modules against a lab built from the new commit. The replay scripts are the round 1 scripts with only the lab project, lab record path, record names (DOC-029r2 access) and screenshot location changed. Screenshots went to private scratch space and are not part of the evidence.
browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium (node_modules/.pnpm), headless, 1440x900, one isolated context per account or device

attempts.disposition: find-your-work and personal-settings passed every step. The search module stopped at its Show more step. The script searches for DOC-029 and needs more than one page of 25 results. The new lab was freshly seeded and held too few DOC-029 records at that time, so no Show more button appeared. This is lab data volume, not an article or product failure. The search module was run again unchanged in the attempt below.
Unchanged search module rerun after other records named DOC-029 existed on the lab. All 17 steps passed.
